recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Core FHIR already reflects the accepted decision, and no follow-up is needed unless future work intentionally changes the external valueset-reference extension in the Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-5782 was a Published FHIR-core vocab change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1. It asked that Coding.valueSet stop carrying a literal server-location ValueSet reference and instead remove Coding.valueSet in favor of the logical valueset-reference extension.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in the historical SVN import as git commit 1fd638cecf / svn r4675, titled "#5782 - remove Coding.valueSet (extension is already defined)". That commit removed Coding.valueSet examples and changed the Coding spreadsheet row to a disabled element with a note that it moved to extension valueset-reference; later source history removed that disabled row entirely.
additional_context: Related Published issues FHIR-7011 and FHIR-7704 later cleaned up remaining Coding.valueSet wording, and FHIR-5783 covered version-specific logical value set references. Those related issues already have audit commits on the combined branch. The valueset-reference extension definition now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack, while current core source links to it from the terminology value-set-reference narrative and extensible-binding guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active Coding source lists Coding.system, Coding.version, Coding.code, Coding.display, and Coding.userSelected, with no Coding.valueSet element or disabled remnant. Current core terminology source points implementers to the ValueSet Reference Extension, and the extension-pack definition is a Coding-context Extension with value[x] constrained to uri.
